ReportQueryDefinition.Name: Опись вложений ф.107
ReportQueryDefinition.Command: SELECT inv.name AS inv_name, c.name AS komu, CONCAT_WS(', ', m.to_zip, m.to_str6, m.to_str5, m.to_str2) AS kuda, it.name AS det_name, it.quantity AS kol, it.cost AS cost, (it.quantity * it.cost) AS total_item_cost, COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY inv.id) AS count_konv FROM inventories inv JOIN mails m ON m.inventory_id = inv.id JOIN counterparties c ON m.counterparty_id = c.id JOIN inventory_items it ON it.inventory_id = inv.id WHERE inv.id = :InventoryId ORDER BY it.id ASC;

SELECT inv.name AS inv_name, c.name AS komu, (COALESCE(m.to_zip || ', ', '') || COALESCE(m.to_str6 || ', ', '') || COALESCE(m.to_str5 || ', ', '') || COALESCE(m.to_str2, '')) AS kuda, it.name AS det_name, it.quantity AS kol, it.cost AS cost, (it.quantity * it.cost) AS total_item_cost, COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY inv.id) AS count_konv FROM inventories inv JOIN mails m ON m.inventory_id = inv.id JOIN counterparties c ON m.counterparty_id = c.id JOIN inventory_items it ON it.inventory_id = inv.id WHERE inv.id = :InventoryId ORDER BY it.id ASC;
